versions.changelog:
LM Studio Discord Bot v1.0.0

- Initial release: Connect a local LM Studio language model directly to Discord as a simple chat bot.
- Bypasses OpenClaw gateway, reducing latency for CPU-only setups.
- Minimal setup: just configure Discord token, LM Studio endpoint, model name, and guild ID.
- No tool access, conversation memory, or advanced Discord features—focused on speed and simplicity.
- Ready-to-use bot.js template provided for quick deployment.
